_comment: Scenario battery for node 6b (claude-haiku-4-5, promoted to production 2026-08-04, replacing qwen35-397b-a17b — see nodes/retired_qwen_node6/ and .claude/rules/node6-haiku-slim-design.md). Ported from the retired Qwen node's own battery (nodes/retired_qwen_node6/node_6b_name_collection_other_scenarios.json) to cover every guardrail the verbose version had, plus new scenarios for FAMILY LOOKUP GATE / DECLARATION GUARD / CHILD FAST-PATH which had zero coverage in the original battery despite being real logic in the node. Mechanism changed for several (INFO PIVOT / CONTACT CLINIC / CANCEL ESCAPE / WRAP-UP now come from nodes/shared/system_prompt.txt) — the pass/fail criterion is preserved unchanged where the requirement itself didn't change. Self-audit result at promotion: 24/24 (100%).

scenarios.name: S1 — EXECUTE fires: name + phone + email-decline all resolved

history.content: I need to book for my son.
I'll put your number on Noah's record — is that right, or do they have their own?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' with booking_for='other' (name collected, phone confirmed 'yes', email declined — all three resolved). FAIL if agent speaks the phrase without the tool call. FAIL if smart_voice_agent is called silently with no spoken phrase. FAIL if agent re-asks about email or asks any further question.

scenarios.name: S2 — NAME step produces the phone question AND the capture_context call in the same turn

history.content: I'd like to book for Amelia Thornton.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'I'll put your number on Amelia's record — is that right, or do they have their own?' AND calls universal_router intent='capture_context' with payload patient_name_raw='Amelia Thornton' in the same response — this write is required for the booking-party edges, not optional. FAIL if universal_router is called silently with no spoken phrase. FAIL if agent speaks the phrase but omits the tool call. FAIL if agent asks 'What is their full name?' first (the name was already given in the caller's first message).

scenarios.name: S3 — Email decline recognised for third-party patient: 'no thanks' resolves the step and EXECUTE fires

history.content: I'll put your number on Karen's record — is that right, or do they have their own?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' ('no thanks' is recognised as a clear decline, all three fields resolved). FAIL if agent re-asks for email. FAIL if agent asks to confirm which number to use again — phone was already confirmed in the previous turn.

scenarios.name: S4 — Correct tool on execute after a prior capture_context call

history.content: Book for my daughter Priya Mehta please.
I'll put your number on Priya's record — is that right, or do they have their own?
priya dot mehta at outlook dot com
So that's Priya Mehta at outlook dot com — is that right?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' with booking_for='other'. FAIL if agent calls universal_router intent='book' (drifted to the recently-used tool). FAIL if agent produces no tool call. FAIL if agent calls universal_router intent='capture_context' again (treating the email confirmation as a new name capture).

scenarios.name: S5 — Phone step: 'that's fine' counted as affirmative, EXECUTE fires on the next resolved field

history.content: It's for my brother Luca Bianchi.
I'll put your number on Luca's record — is that right, or do they have their own?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' ('that's fine' is a listed phone affirmative, 'nope, don't have one' is a clear email decline — all resolved). FAIL if agent asks to confirm which number to use again. FAIL if agent asks for email again.

scenarios.name: S6 — Medicare/private-health question mid name-collection routes to INFO PIVOT (inherited from system prompt)

history.content: I need to book for my son.
What is your son's full name?
Uh, do you get anything from re-- uh, Medicare or private health insurance?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks exactly one filler phrase AND calls universal_router intent='info_pivot' with called_number, caller_id in the same turn (the system prompt's INFO PIVOT block covers this — no node-local override needed). FAIL if agent fabricates a coverage answer directly. FAIL if agent calls smart_voice_agent instead of universal_router. FAIL if agent calls universal_router silently with no filler phrase. FAIL if agent asks 'What is your son's full name?' again without addressing the coverage question.

scenarios.name: S7 — Boundary: payment-plan question fires node-local FINANCIAL ENQUIRY, not system-prompt INFO PIVOT

history.content: What is your daughter's full name?
Can we set up a payment plan for this?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'Our team handles billing directly — would you like me to get someone to call you back?' (payment plans are billing-admin, this node's FINANCIAL ENQUIRY block fires). FAIL if agent routes via universal_router intent='info_pivot'. FAIL if agent fabricates a payment-plan answer directly.

scenarios.name: S7b — Boundary: plain cost question goes to the system prompt's PRICING QUERY, not FINANCIAL ENQUIRY (deliberate change from the Qwen version — see node6-haiku-slim-design.md)

history.content: What is your daughter's full name?
Actually, how much does it cost?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent does NOT offer a billing callback for a plain cost question with appointment_type_id already resolved — this should go through the system prompt's PRICING QUERY instead. FAIL if agent says 'Our team handles billing directly — would you like me to get someone to call you back?' for a plain cost question.

scenarios.name: S8 — RESUMPTION after aside: no 'Now,' refocusing prefix

history.content: I need to book for my son.
What is your son's full name?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent's response states the price AND re-asks the pending name question in its original exact wording with no refocusing lead-in, e.g. 'The cost for the Initial Hand Therapy Consultation is one hundred and sixty dollars. What is your son's full name?'. FAIL if the resumption is prefixed with 'Now,' or 'So,'. FAIL if the agent omits the pending name question.

scenarios.name: S10 — Parking question mid name-collection routes to INFO PIVOT (inherited), never fabricated

history.content: I need to book for my son.
What is your son's full name?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks exactly one filler phrase AND calls universal_router intent='info_pivot' in the same turn. FAIL if the agent fabricates any specific parking answer instead of routing to info_pivot. FAIL if agent calls smart_voice_agent instead of universal_router. FAIL if agent calls universal_router silently with no filler phrase. FAIL if agent asks 'What is your son's full name?' again without addressing the parking question.

scenarios.name: TOOL2 — FINANCIAL ENQUIRY callback_request payload includes caller_name, not just callback_reason (found missing in a post-promotion tool-name/scoping audit 2026-08-04)

history.content: I need to book for my son.
I'll put your number on Leo's record — is that right, or do they have their own?
Actually, can we set up a payment plan?
Our team handles billing directly — would you like me to get someone to call you back?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent calls universal_router intent='callback_request' with a payload that includes BOTH caller_name AND callback_reason. FAIL if the payload includes callback_reason but omits caller_name entirely.

scenarios.name: EC1 — Jukes/Dukes phonetic mismatch for third-party patient: silent-correct spelling from email

history.content: I need to book for my son, his name's Anthony Dukes.
I'll put your number on Anthony's record — is that right, or does he have his own?
It's a, n, t, h, o, n, y, dot, j, u, k, e, s, at gmail dot com.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent silently corrects the stored surname to 'Jukes' and proceeds directly to the email confirmation question, with NO separate question about the Dukes/Jukes discrepancy. FAIL if the agent asks 'Is his last name spelled with a J or a D?'. FAIL if the agent keeps 'Dukes' and never reconciles the mismatch.

scenarios.name: EC2 — Significant name/email mismatch for third-party patient still triggers the clarifying question

history.content: Booking for my daughter, Rebecca Sinclair.
I'll put your number on Rebecca's record — is that right, or does she have her own?
It's r, dot, montgomery, at outlook dot com.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent asks a clarifying question noting the surname in the email ('Montgomery') doesn't match the surname given ('Sinclair'). FAIL if the agent silently overwrites 'Sinclair' with 'Montgomery' without asking. FAIL if the agent ignores the mismatch and proceeds straight to execute.

scenarios.name: AG1 — Spelling-confidence gate fires on sound-alike pair (Cain/Kane) for third-party patient

history.content: I'd like to book for my husband, his last name's Cain.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the agent asks a spelling-confirmation question distinguishing the two spellings, e.g. 'Is that C-A-I-N or K-A-N-E?'. FAIL if the agent assumes one spelling without confirming which. FAIL if the agent asks for the full name again instead of a targeted spelling question.

scenarios.name: WL1 — EXECUTE RECOVERY fires: 'are you there?' after a dropped tool call

history.content: I need to book for my son.
I'll put your number on Max's record — is that right, or do they have their own?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' with booking_for='other' — RECOVERY fires: prior turn already said the execute phrase, no smart_voice_agent response since, name+phone+email all resolved. FAIL if agent says a generic wait phrase like 'I'm still here, one moment.' with no tool call (the system prompt's default WEBHOOK LAG fired instead of RECOVERY). FAIL if agent calls universal_router instead of smart_voice_agent. FAIL if agent re-asks any collection question.

scenarios.name: WL2 — RECOVERY does NOT fire before collection is complete — the system prompt's own WEBHOOK LAG default applies instead

history.content: I'd like to book for my mum.
I'll put your number on Sandra's record — is that right, or do they have their own?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent says the system prompt's standard wait phrase (e.g. 'Sorry, I'm still here — just one moment.') with no tool call and no variable changes — RECOVERY does NOT apply here because the prior agent turn was 'What's their email address?', not the execute phrase, so the RECOVERY precondition fails and the system prompt's own WEBHOOK LAG rule is what should fire. FAIL if agent calls any tool. FAIL if agent re-asks the email question directly instead of the wait phrase.

scenarios.name: NCZ1 — No tool call between phone confirmation and the email question

history.content: I need to book for my sister.
So that is E, M, M, A, R, O, D, R, I, G, U, E, Z — is that right?
I'll put your number on Emma's record — is that right, or does she have her own?

scenarios.expected_behavior: After phone confirmation, the agent should ask for the email address with zero tool calls in that turn — no capture_context, no universal_router, no smart_voice_agent (email is not yet resolved, so EXECUTE cannot fire). A tool call in this transition turn is a protocol violation.

scenarios.name: PC1 — phone not known: the combined NAME-step question asks for a number, not 'is that right'

history.content: I need to book for my mum.
Of course, what's her full name?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'What's a good number to reach Margaret on?' AND calls universal_router intent='capture_context' with patient_name_raw='Margaret Thompson' in the same turn (phone genuinely unknown, so the NAME step's phone-unknown question variant applies). FAIL if agent speaks 'I'll put your number on Margaret's record — is that right, or does she have her own?' (wrong variant — phone isn't actually known here). FAIL if the tool is called silently without the spoken question.

scenarios.name: PC2 — phone already known: the combined NAME-step question asks 'is that right', not for a number

history.content: I need to book for my daughter.
Of course, what's her full name?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'I'll put your number on Emily's record — is that right, or does she have her own?' AND calls universal_router intent='capture_context' with patient_name_raw='Emily Chen' (phone already known via system__caller_id). FAIL if agent speaks 'What's a good number to reach Emily on?' (wrong variant — phone was already known). FAIL if the tool is called silently without spoken output.

scenarios.name: FP1 — KNOWN FAST-PATH: all DVs pre-set, fires smart_voice_agent NOT universal_router on the first turn
scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' (patient_name_raw, caller_email, and phone are all already set, no capture_context call has fired yet, smart_voice_agent hasn't been called — KNOWN FAST-PATH fires). FAIL if agent calls universal_router for anything — universal_router cannot book. FAIL if agent asks for the patient's name, phone, or email (all already known). FAIL if agent produces no tool call.

scenarios.name: FT1 — First turn, patient name unknown: no recap, directly asks for the patient's name

history.content: Yeah eleven should work, it is for my wife.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks for the patient's name directly (e.g. 'What is their full name?') with NO booking recap before it — this design never has a recap block, DECLARATION GUARD has nothing to extract here since no name was stated, FAMILY LOOKUP GATE proceeds to step 1 (assume no family match) since a lookup either returns nothing or hasn't been tested here. FAIL if agent says ANY recap phrase such as 'Perfect, 11 AM Saturday the 1st...'. FAIL if agent makes any tool call this turn before a name exists to look up or collect.

scenarios.name: FAM1 — DECLARATION GUARD: caller states who the booking is for unprompted, no lookup call, no echo

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment for my son Jake.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent silently captures 'Jake' as the family member name and moves straight into the NAME step's combined phone question using 'Jake' — NO lookup_family tool call (DECLARATION GUARD short-circuits FAMILY LOOKUP GATE once a name is already stated) and NO echo/confirmation of the name back to the caller before proceeding. FAIL if agent calls smart_voice_agent intent='lookup_family' anyway. FAIL if agent asks 'What is their full name?' again — the name was already given. FAIL if agent repeats 'Jake' back as a confirmation question before proceeding.

scenarios.name: FAM2 — FAMILY LOOKUP GATE: multiple family members returned, caller must be asked which

history.content: I'd like to book an appointment please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent first speaks a filler phrase and calls smart_voice_agent intent='lookup_family', then — once the tool result lists multiple family members with none resolved — asks 'I have [N] family members on file: [names]. Who would you like to book for, or is it someone else?' in that same turn as the lookup result is processed. FAIL if agent skips the lookup call entirely when nothing is known yet. FAIL if agent guesses which family member without asking.

scenarios.name: FAM3 — FAMILY LOOKUP GATE: no family members found, proceeds straight to step 1

history.content: I'd like to book an appointment for my daughter please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Note: 'for my daughter' with no name given doesn't satisfy DECLARATION GUARD (no name to extract), so the lookup fires. PASS if agent speaks a filler phrase, calls smart_voice_agent intent='lookup_family', and — once the result comes back with nothing found — proceeds to ask 'What is their full name?' in the same turn or the next, without inventing a family member or asking the caller to repeat the relationship. FAIL if agent skips the lookup and asks for the name outright without ever calling lookup_family. FAIL if agent gets stuck after a 'not found' result with no next question.

scenarios.name: PS1 — Step 2 PHONE: affirmative to 'is that right' resolves phone and goes to email, no re-asking

history.content: I need to book for my son.
Of course, what's his full name?
I'll put your number on Noah's record — is that right, or does he have his own?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent proceeds directly to step 3 — asks 'What's their email address?' (or equivalent) — with NO phone question in this turn (MANDATORY PART 1 sees caller_phone is non-empty, so phone was known when step 1 ran; MANDATORY PART 2 processes the affirmative and goes directly to step 3). FAIL if agent asks for a phone number. FAIL if agent calls any tool this turn (email is not yet resolved, so EXECUTE cannot fire; no capture_context needed here).

scenarios.name: CHILD1 — CHILD FAST-PATH: paediatric appointment type uses the caller's own phone silently, no phone question

history.content: I'd like to book my daughter in for a paediatric assessment.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent uses the caller's own number as patient_phone silently and asks for email directly, with NO phone question of any kind ('is that right, or do they have their own?' must not appear) — CHILD FAST-PATH applies because the appointment type is paediatric and a phone number is already known. FAIL if agent asks the standard phone-record question. FAIL if agent asks 'What's a good number to reach Ruby on?'.

scenarios.name: FMP1 — family_member_phone_known skips the phone step entirely, goes straight to email

history.content: I'd like to book for my friend Blake Firestone.
Of course — I'll put your number on Blake's record — is that right, or do they have their own?
Actually, he gave me his number, it's 0437 885 154.

dvs.family_member_phone_known: family member phone already on file — skip the phone question entirely. In the same turn as capture_context, ask: 'And do they have an email address for the booking?' Go directly to step 3, do not ask the phone question.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent skips the phone step entirely and asks for the email address (e.g. 'Do they have an email address for the booking?') with NO phone question — family_member_phone_known DV instructs the agent to skip to step 3. FAIL if agent asks 'I'll put your number on Blake's record — is that right, or do they have their own?' (phone question must not fire when family_member_phone_known is set). FAIL if agent asks 'What's a good number to reach Blake on?'

scenarios.name: FMP2 — EXECUTE uses family_member_phone as patient_phone when family_member_phone_known was set

history.content: I'd like to book for my friend.
And do they have an email address for the booking?

dvs.family_member_phone_known: family member phone already on file — skip the phone question entirely. In the same turn as capture_context, ask: 'And do they have an email address for the booking?' Go directly to step 3, do not ask the phone question.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' with patient_phone='0437885154' (the family_member_phone DV value, not the caller's own number +61412345678) — all three fields resolved (name via DV, phone via family_member_phone, email declined). FAIL if agent uses caller's own number (+61412345678) as patient_phone when family_member_phone_known was set. FAIL if agent re-asks for a phone number. FAIL if agent asks for email again.

scenarios.name: PNS1 — patient_name_raw pre-set on entry: capture_context + phone offer fire on first turn
scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'I'll put your number on Blake's record — is that right, or do they have their own?' AND calls universal_router intent='capture_context' with payload patient_name_raw='Blake Firestone' in the same turn — patient_name_raw is pre-set so NAME step goes straight to the combined capture_context + phone question, not 'What is their full name?'. FAIL if agent asks 'What is their full name?' (name already known from DV). FAIL if agent asks 'What's Blake's phone number?' or 'What's a good number to reach Blake on?' (wrong variant — caller_phone is non-empty, so the 'use your number?' variant applies). FAIL if capture_context is called without the spoken phrase (must be combined). FAIL if agent asks for email directly without first handling the phone step.

scenarios.name: PBN1 — Post-booking name correction for the family member, using patient_id from the book result

history.content: I'd like to book my son in for physio.
I'll put your number on Peter's record — is that right, or do they have their own?
[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": true, "message": "Peter's confirmed for Thursday at 4 PM with Dr Lee.", "patient": {"id": "91207", "first_name": "Peter", "last_name": "Novak", "email": ""}}
Peter's confirmed for Thursday at 4 PM with Dr Lee.
Actually, it's spelled Peader, not Peter — P, E, A, D, E, R.
So that's Peader, P, E, A, D, E, R — is that right?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one filler phrase AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='update_contact_detail' with patient_id='91207' (the patient.id from the most recent smart_voice_agent book result — the family member's record, not the caller's own), field='first_name', value='Peader'. FAIL if patient_id is omitted (would incorrectly fall back to a caller-phone lookup and update the CALLER's own record instead of Peter/Peader's). FAIL if the agent only acknowledges the correction verbally with no tool call. FAIL if field='full_name' (only the first name changed).

scenarios.name: SR1 — service_reselection_required routes to change_service, not the generic failure line

history.content: I need to book my daughter Amelia for a remedial massage.
I'll put your number on Amelia's record — is that right, or does she have her own?
Do you have an email address for the booking?

[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": false, "error": "service_not_found", "message": "I'm sorry, that's not a service we currently offer, so let's get the right one sorted for your booking.", "service_reselection_required": "true"}

scenarios.expected_behavior: Speak the message field verbatim ("I'm sorry, that's not a service we currently offer, so let's get the right one sorted for your booking.") with no additions, then in the same turn call universal_router intent="change_service" with called_number and caller_id. Must NOT say the generic "I'm having trouble finalizing that booking." line — service_reselection_required is set, so the more specific branch applies.

scenarios.name: SR2 — ordinary booking failure (no service_reselection_required) still uses the generic fallback

history.content: Book my husband in for a physio appointment.
I'll put your number on Marcus's record — is that right, or does he have his own?
Do you have an email address for the booking?
[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": false, "error": "slot_unavailable", "message": "That slot was just taken by another caller."}

scenarios.expected_behavior: Regression guard: this failure has no service_reselection_required field, so say the generic "I'm having trouble finalizing that booking." line — must NOT call universal_router intent="change_service" or invent a service-retirement explanation that isn't in this response.

scenarios.name: SR3 — slot_not_available routes to change_time, not the generic failure line

history.content: Book my husband in for a physio appointment.
I'll put your number on Marcus's record — is that right, or does he have his own?
Do you have an email address for the booking?
[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": false, "error": "slot_not_available", "message": "I'm sorry, that time slot is no longer available. Let me find you another option."}

scenarios.expected_behavior: Speak the message field verbatim with no additions, then in the same turn call universal_router intent="change_time" with called_number and caller_id. Must NOT say the generic "I'm having trouble finalizing that booking." line. Must NOT confuse this with SR2's "slot_unavailable" (different string, generic fallback).

scenarios.name: PC3 — Long-context OFFER QUESTION: after a completed self-booking flow, patient_name_raw arrives via route_other (not capture_context), caller_id/caller_phone non-empty since call start — must still ask the OFFER QUESTION, not the phone-unknown question

history.content: Hi, it's Betty Chad, I was looking to make an appointment.
Hi Betty! Sounds good, let's get that sorted. Just one moment.
Is this for foot pain, heel pain, skin or toenail care, or something else?
I'm diabetic and need my feet checked. My husband has arthritis in his feet too and could use some help.
That sounds rough. We can definitely help with that.
We're open Wednesdays and Thursdays — when would suit you?
Twelve twenty or one thirty works — can my husband get in then too? Don Child.
Sure thing — so I'll book you in for twelve twenty on Thursday. For your husband Don, I'll need a separate appointment — twelve twenty, one thirty, or a different time?
One thirty would be best for him.
[universal_router response]: {"intent": "confirm_time", "success": true, "message": "Great, twelve twenty on Thursday it is.", "booking_for": "self"}
Do you have an email address for the booking?
It's buddiechard, all one word, B-U-D-D-I-E, C-H-A-R-D, at gmail dot com.
So that's B, U, D, D, I, E, C, H, A, R, D at gmail dot com — is that right?

[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": true, "message": "Wonderful Betty! You're confirmed with Tetyana for Diabetic Foot Assessment on Thursday at 12:20 PM.", "booking_id": "2029468893906481017", "patient_name": "Betty Chad", "booking_for": "self"}
Wonderful Betty! You're confirmed with Tetyana for Diabetic Foot Assessment on Thursday at twelve twenty PM. See you then!

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'I'll put your number on Don's record — is that right, or does he have his own?' (or equivalent naming Don) AND calls universal_router intent='capture_context' with payload patient_name_raw='Don Child' in the same turn — caller_id/caller_phone are non-empty (they have been since the very first turn, unchanged by the self-booking flow that just completed), so the OFFER QUESTION variant applies even though patient_name_raw arrived via route_other rather than a capture_context call in this node. FAIL if agent asks 'What's a good number to reach Don on?' or any phone-unknown-variant question — this is the exact live regression being tested: a long prior self-booking flow in history must not cause the agent to treat caller_id/caller_phone as unknown or already-consumed. FAIL if agent asks 'What is his full name?' (name is already set via DV).

scenarios.name: PH2 — Phone number correction: agent must use the FINAL corrected/confirmed number in the EXECUTE payload, not the first misheard digits

history.content: It's for my husband, Don Child.
What's a good number to reach him on?
So that's zero four zero nine, zero two two, five five two four — is that right?
You're a bit quick for me there. Zero four zero nine, double two, double five, two four.
Got it — zero four zero nine, double two, double five, two four. Is that right?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' with patient_phone='0409225524' — the digits from the CORRECTED readback the caller actually confirmed ('double two, double five, two four' = 2,2,5,5,2,4 after 0409), not '0409022524' (the digits from the FIRST, unconfirmed readback the caller explicitly said was too fast to follow). This is the exact live regression being tested: when a caller corrects a misheard number and then confirms the corrected readback, the corrected number is the one that was actually agreed — the first, superseded readback must not leak into the booking payload. FAIL if patient_phone is '0409022524' or any value other than '0409225524'. FAIL if agent asks the caller to repeat the number a third time.

scenarios.name: SR4 — practitioner_service_mismatch routes to change_practitioner, not the generic failure line

history.content: I need to book my daughter Amelia for a remedial massage with Nicole.
I'll put your number on Amelia's record — is that right, or does she have her own?
Do you have an email address for the booking?

[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": false, "error": "practitioner_service_mismatch", "message": "I'm sorry, that practitioner doesn't offer that service. Could you let me know again which practitioner and service you'd like to book?"}

scenarios.expected_behavior: Speak the message field verbatim with no additions, then in the same turn call universal_router intent="change_practitioner" with called_number and caller_id. Must NOT say the generic "I'm having trouble finalizing that booking." line, and must NOT call intent="change_service".

scenarios.name: WAITLIST OFFER FOLLOW-UP — caller accepts; waitlist_add payload must include requested_date

history.content: I'd like to book for my sister Emma Jones.
I'll need to collect Emma's details. What's the phone number for Emma's record?

[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": true, "message": "Emma's appointment is confirmed for Wednesday at 3pm with Sarah. Would you like me to also add them to the waitlist in case something sooner comes up?"}
Emma's appointment is confirmed for Wednesday at 3pm with Sarah. Would you like me to also add them to the waitlist in case something sooner comes up?
Yes please, that would be great.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent says 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls universal_router intent='waitlist_add' with payload that includes requested_date={{appointment_date}} AND booking_for='other' AND patient_name='Emma Jones'. FAIL if: agent calls wrap_up directly without calling waitlist_add. FAIL if: payload omits requested_date. FAIL if: payload uses booking_for='self'.

scenarios.name: RC1 — Email single-character correction escalates to anchor word

history.content: I'd like to book an appointment for my son.
What's a good number to reach Chris on?
So that's C, S, M, I, T, H, eight, one, at outlook dot com — is that right?
No, it's an S not a C — s-smith81.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the correction confirmation pairs the corrected letter with a short disambiguating word (e.g. "an S, as in Sam, instead of a C, as in Charlie") rather than repeating bare letters. FAIL if the readback says only "an S instead of a C" with no anchor word — this is a retry after the first bare-letter readback already needed correcting, so RE-CONFIRMATION ESCALATION applies.

scenarios.name: EC1 — text-me-instead sets email_capture_requested in EXECUTE payload

history.content: I'd like to book an appointment for my wife.
I'll put your number on Maria's record — is that right, or do they have their own?
Can you just text me instead?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks exactly 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' with patient_email omitted AND email_capture_requested: true included in the payload (name resolved, phone resolved via the caller's own number, email step resolved via the text-me-instead outcome — EXECUTE fires this same turn). FAIL if email_capture_requested is missing from the payload. FAIL if agent asks any further question instead of executing.

scenarios.name: EC2 — plain decline does NOT set email_capture_requested

history.content: I need to book my son in for an appointment.
I'll put your number on Leo's record — is that right, or do they have their own?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks exactly 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' with BOTH patient_email and email_capture_requested omitted entirely from the payload — a plain decline is not the text-me-instead outcome, so EMAIL-CAPTURE-VIA-SMS does not apply. FAIL if email_capture_requested is included (with any value) for this plain decline.
